name: IBGE
summary: Brazil's statistics office (IBGE) aggregate data, the API behind SIDRA: survey and census tables by period and place, with their metadata.
notes: Documentation and labels are in Portuguese; agregado = SIDRA table, variavel = measure, classificacao = dimension, categoria = member, localidade = place.
Geographic levels include N2 region, N3 state (UF), N6 municipality and N7 metropolitan region; BR is Brazil. An aggregate's metadata lists the levels it covers.
Several IDs in one path or query value are joined with |.

endpoints.name: List aggregates by survey
endpoints.summary: Every aggregate (SIDRA table), grouped by survey, optionally filtered by period, subject, classification, frequency or geographic level.

periodo.description: Only aggregates with results for this period, frequency-prefixed, e.g. P5[202001] (January 2020).

nivel.description: Geographic level with results, e.g. N6 (municipalities).

notes: Identifiers for subjects, frequencies, periods and levels are listed in the docs' identifier base.

endpoints.name: Get an aggregate's metadata
endpoints.summary: Name, survey, subject, frequency and range, geographic levels, variables and classifications with their categories.

agregado.description: Aggregate (SIDRA table) ID, e.g. 1705 or 1712; each SIDRA table is one aggregate.

notes: Read this first: it gives the variable, classification and level IDs the data calls take.

endpoints.name: List an aggregate's periods
endpoints.summary: Every period an aggregate has results for, with labels and last modification.

agregado.description: Aggregate (SIDRA table) ID, e.g. 1705 or 1712; each SIDRA table is one aggregate.

endpoints.name: List an aggregate's places
endpoints.summary: Places an aggregate has results for at one or more geographic levels.

agregado.description: Aggregate (SIDRA table) ID, e.g. 1705 or 1712; each SIDRA table is one aggregate.

nivel.description: Levels joined by |, e.g. N7|N6 (metropolitan regions and municipalities); the aggregate's metadata lists its levels.

endpoints.name: Get variable values for chosen periods
endpoints.summary: Values of an aggregate's variables for given periods and places, per category combination.

agregado.description: Aggregate (SIDRA table) ID, e.g. 1705 or 1712; each SIDRA table is one aggregate.

periodos.description: Periods joined by |, ranges as START-END (201701-201706), or a negative number for the latest n (-6); a negative value cannot be mixed with others.

variavel.description: Variable IDs joined by |, e.g. 214|1982; allxp for every variable of the aggregate, all to add the API's computed percentage variables.

localidades.description: Places, separated by |: BR for Brazil, or N<level>[ids], e.g. N3[33,35] (states RJ and SP), N6[5208707] (a municipality), N7 (every metropolitan region). Levels nest: N6[N3[33,35]] is every municipality in RJ and SP.

classificacao.description: Restrict categories as <classification>[<categories>], several joined by |, e.g. 226[4844]|218[4780]; [all] for every category. Unset: only the Total category (0).

view.description: OLAP for OLAP notation, or flat: first array item is metadata, rows follow.

notes: At most 100,000 values per call (categories x periods x places); over it answers 500.
Special values: '-' zero not from rounding, '..' not applicable, '...' not available, 'X' withheld for confidentiality.

endpoints.name: Get variable values for the last six periods
endpoints.summary: Same as aggregates.values over the six latest periods.
